 College Basketball on Kalshi: Prediction Markets for Tuesday’s Matchups
 | 
 Photo Credit: Craig Dudek 
 This article contains references to products from our advertisers and/or partners, and we may receive compensation when you click on links to products and services 
 Several ranked college basketball teams are in action on Tuesday, including an in-season tournament in Las Vegas. View these previews before using apps like Kalshi to make trades on the action.
 Player Era 8 Games on Tuesday
 The Players Era 8 tournament is taking place at Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas.
 Notre Dame vs. Florida (4:30 PM ET | ESPN): Neutral-site showcase featuring the Gators as solid favorites in early market sentiment over the Irish, driven by Florida’s interior scoring depth and Notre Dame adjusting in non-conference tournament play.
 UNLV vs. Kansas (9:30 PM ET | ESPN): Despite UNLV playing in its hometown of Las Vegas, the Jayhawks are projected as substantial double-digit favorites (~11.5 to 13.5 points) in early market pricing given Kansas’s talent advantage and rebounding edge.
 Auburn vs. West Virginia (12:00 AM ET | ESPN): Late-night neutral-site finale where Bruce Pearl’s Tigers are strong market favorites (~9.5 to 11.5 points) over the Mountaineers, with high tempo and transition efficiency driving market confidence toward Auburn.
 Other Top Matchups
 Illinois vs. Duke (7:00 PM ET, Cameron Indoor Stadium, Durham | ESPN): True road test for the Illini in Durham. Duke opens as home chalk in market projections (~6.5 to 8.5 points) behind elite perimeter talent and Cameron’s home-court advantage.
 You can apply the Kalshi promo code to take Duke at 78% or go with Illinois at 23%.
 Michigan State vs. Tennessee (9:00 PM ET, Thompson-Boling Arena, Knoxville | ESPN2): High-profile clash between Tom Izzo and Rick Barnes. Prediction markets heavily favor Tennessee at home (~6.5 to 7.5-point favorites) in what projects as a low-scoring, defensive battle with a modest total.
